2026 Tryouts/Evaluations



    


    

Tryouts/Evaluations Saturday March 7th at:
 

Northmont Middle School 
810 National Rd, Clayton 45315

 


BASEBALL AND SOFTBALL PLAYERS.

Boys 8-14 years only!
(Returning players to MJBB 11-12 YR OLD need not to  attend) 

GIRLS 9 to 12 years old only! 

Also 6 year old boys and girls wanting to move up to Coach Pitch.

All Players must attend 2 out of 3 sessions.
